Identify the principal and exact appointee. Specify records, distributions, correction and liability scope. Check that registration or other powers needed for the activity are separately satisfied.
A contract cannot confer statutory powers the appointee otherwise lacks.

Securitize Transfer Agent, LLC: The 2026 public-company subsidiary exhibit identifies Securitize Transfer Agent, LLC, and BlackRock's July 2026 BRSRV prospectus appoints that exact entity as transfer agent. Older TA and BUIDL filings use Securitize LLC, establishing the historical name boundary rather than a still-unresolved current entity.
The Depository Trust Company: SEC lists DTC as a registered clearing agency.
